title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
abstract: arXiv:2609.04304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Iris-mini and Iris-pro, two search agents trained at the 35B-A3B and 397B-A17B scales, together with the data pipeline and training recipe behind them. Tasks are reverse-constructed from the hyperlink structure of a web corpus: we author multi-hop chains over an entity graph distilled from a seed page and its out-links, rewrite every non-answer entity into a descriptive reference so that no clue can be resolved by string matching, and admit only questions that a reference model fails closed-book yet solves once the supporting evidence is supplied. These questions are then turned into trajectories, which are filtered at both the trajectory and the turn level before SFT. The policy is then optimized by RL against live search, with the reward judge and the observation summarizer served inside the training cluster, and with over-long rollouts interrupted at the request level and resumed from their committed prefix at the next step

translated_abstract: 我们提出了 Iris-mini 和 Iris-pro，两个分别在 35B-A3B 和 397B-A17B 规模上训练的搜索智能体，并介绍其背后的数据流水线与训练方案。任务是从网页语料库的超链接结构中反向构建的：我们在从种子页面及其外链提炼出的实体图谱上编写多跳问题链，将每个非答案实体改写为描述性指称，从而确保任何线索都无法通过字符串匹配直接解决；并且只收录那些参考模型在闭卷情况下无法回答、但在提供支持证据后能够解决的问题。这些问题随后被转化为轨迹，并在 SFT 之前于轨迹层面和轮次层面进行过滤。随后，策略通过强化学习针对实时搜索进行优化，其中奖励评判器与观察摘要器均部署在训练集群内部；超长的推理过程会在请求层面被中断，并在下一步从其已提交的前缀处恢复继续。
tldr: 本文提出两个搜索智能体 Iris-mini 和 Iris-pro，其核心创新在于从网页超链接结构反向构建多跳问答数据（通过描述性改写杜绝字符串匹配作弊、筛选闭卷失败但有证据可解的问题），再结合针对实时搜索的强化学习训练，并在训练集群内高效服务奖励评判与超长推理恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Iris-mini and Iris-pro, two search agents trained via a novel data pipeline that reverse-constructs multi-hop QA tasks from web hyperlink structures—with descriptive rewrites to prevent string-matching shortcuts—and an RL recipe optimized against live search with in-cluster reward judging and resumable over-long rollouts.
